verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents an IM Gateway ("Agents where you already chat") and a Messenger docs section with dedicated pages for Telegram, Slack and Discord, so the product itself lets you reach agents from several of the named messengers. The evidence shows only navigation titles and a tagline, not setup or behavior detail. missing for 10: WhatsApp support, iMessage support, substantive setup/usage documentation for the messenger integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can talk to my assistant from the messengers I already use — WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or iMessage — not just a bespoke web page

citations.quote: IM Gateway — Agents where you already chat
